records.text: The Shaklee Corporation created the first multivitamin in America, grew into a large multi-level marketing company with an evangelical sales force, and held a 25-year contract with NASA.
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: The Shaklee Corporation was the first company that ever created a multivitamin in America. It grew to be a massive, ... basically a multi-level marketing corporation, ... which, like I said, commanded this evangelical sales force. ... gospel is what this is really about and it grew to be a massive company that engaged in a 25-year contract with NASA.

verification.notes: Shaklee company history supports its claim to an early US multivitamin and its products flying on NASA missions, and independent reporting describes its large multilevel-marketing network. No evidence was found for the more specific assertion of a 25-year NASA contract, so the compound statement is only partly supported.

sources.title: Shaklee US Health and Wellness Study
sources.relevance: Company material makes the first-multivitamin and NASA-mission claims but does not document a 25-year NASA contract.

records.text: The moon landing did not happen.
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: The moon landing can't have happened, in fact. ... If you want to follow the facts, ... the moon landing can't have happened.

verification.notes: The Apollo 11 landing is supported by independent lines of physical evidence including lunar samples, continuing laser-ranging retroreflectors, tracking data, and later orbital images showing the descent stage and astronaut trails. The assertion that the landing did not occur is false.

sources.title: NASA: Apollo 11 landing site imaged by Lunar Reconnaissance Orbiter
sources.relevance: Orbital imagery shows the descent stage and astronaut trails at the Apollo 11 landing site.

records.text: If his Wikipedia biography is to be believed, Stanley Clark Moore has a U.S. Air Force background and later worked for NASA.
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: She is married to a man named Stanley Clark Moore. ... He has an Air Force background, ... also went to go work for NASA, ... if his Wikipedia is to be believed for a little bit,

verification.notes: Available biographical information says Stanley Clark Moore grew up in an Air Force family and applied for a NASA research grant, but NASA funding was cut before he could work there. It does not show his own Air Force service and directly conflicts with the claim that he later worked for NASA.

sources.title: Stan Moore director biography
sources.relevance: Biographical account says he grew up in an Air Force family and applied for a NASA grant, but did not serve in the Air Force or work for NASA.
